title: StudyProtocol
description: The protocol part of a study manifest (10D-2, D-1366; review 14 M14-1): what the coordinating centre fixes for every site, read from rulesets/<ID>/ by tb_common.study_manifest. Its canonical serialisation (keys sorted, no spaces, UTF-8) hashes to criteria_sha256, the same on every site that adopts it; a site edit to any of it is refused. The canonical form is written in D-1366. Schema version 1.0.0.

criteria_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical serialisation of schema, manifest and files (every key but this one)

manifest.description: the protocol fields of rulesets/<ID>/manifest.yaml, each value as ruleset_manifest.schema.json defines it (defaults explicit, nulls left out); models carries only judge_prompt, the judge's prompt pin of a manifest without prompt_pins (which model serves is the site's)

files.description: the protocol's files of rulesets/<ID>/ by relative path (ir/*.json, valuesets/*.json, cql/elm/*.json, cql/*.cql, sql/*.sql, labels.yaml, tests/patients.ndjson, tests/expected.json, and the file docx_template names), each the sha256 of its canonical bytes (D-1366); a criterion IR file without the site's review record (who, when, comment, approved or draft); no other file is hashed

additionalProperties.description: lowercase hex sha256; the key is a path relative to rulesets/<ID>/, never absolute and never with ..
